title: The Storage Room Murder
motive_summary: Nadia Cole was being blackmailed by Clara Wells over a secret ledger.
overview_text: 08:42 — Clara Wells, owner of Hobbs Cafe, found dead in the cafe storage room by Priya Shah. The cafe opened at 08:30. Several villagers passed nearby between 08:00 and 08:40. No one claims to have seen what happened. The morning can be rewound from 06:30.
